summary: Correct 'sich lange unterhalten hatte' to 'sich lange unterhalten hatten'
rationale: The subject sie is plural, as confirmed by Turoyo žġili and aʕlayye. The coordinated German clause already has sie ... gesprochen; the auxiliary must be hatten. The supplied corpus translation repeats hatte, so this is an inherited German agreement error rather than a claimed difference from the edition.
U=muxtar denotes the village headman here; the supplied edition translation has Schultheiß. Schuhheiß is a misspelling.
The parenthetical gloss identifies the plural object sie of closing the eyes; the plural of Auge is Augen. This corrects an inflection slip and preserves the editorial parenthesis.
The past-tense clause with sah requires the preterit verschloss of verschließen. Verschliess is not the required past-tense form.
Szene is feminine, so its accusative demonstrative is diese.
